I could not set the P-1043 discount to 17%, so nothing was changed or applied.

I signed in and opened the Pricing page. P-1043 (Marine Filter 93) is still at 0%. Its "Set discount" dialog only offers a 0%–60% scale with no text or number input. Clicking the scale, pressing the arrow keys and dragging all left the value at 0%. I then cancelled the dialog, so no discount was applied to any product.

The scale may need a different interaction than the automation layer can perform, or it may be a broken control. Someone with access to the page could check whether the scale responds to a manual drag or a keyboard focus.
